Interpretation: He needs 75 large jelly beans to feel full. He can eat twice as many medium beans as large beans. And 3 small beans equal 1 medium bean. So we need number of small beans he can eat.

We need to compute: large beans = 75. Medium beans = 2 * large = 150. Small beans: each medium = 3 small. So small beans = 150 * 3 = 450.

Thus answer: 450 small beans.
